title: K2 Space quote
description: A window-tall band of full-bleed footage (80% of the window on phones) with a three-line 72px quote centred on it, a small attribution and a square near-black button under it. The footage settles from 115% and blurred to sharp as it scrolls in; the quote and attribution rise 15px into place, the button just after.
notes: always dark (it carries the `dark` class): light type over footage in either mode
CSS only; without scroll-timeline support or under reduced motion everything simply shows
name: k2space-quote

props.description: the quote, without quotation marks (they are added)
